name: Raydium API
note: 200 pools: tvl, volume, real APR, fee rates, symbols. Our richest Solana source.

name: DexScreener
note: Venue coverage no one else gives us: orca, meteora, pumpswap, rhea, robinhood long tail. No key.

name: GeckoTerminal
note: Top pools per network + universal live search. No key. Fallback where no venue API exists.

name: DeFiLlama DEX volumes
note: Venue ranking by 24h volume only — never pool rows. Proved Raydium is 5th on Solana.

name: Orca API
note: Serves raw whirlpool accounts only: no symbols, no USD. Unusable for rows without keyed services.

name: Jupiter Lite API
note: Tokens + prices, no key. Proven working; role: symbol/price enrichment.

name: Meteora DLMM API
note: All probed paths 404. Covered via DexScreener instead.

name: Uniswap
note: No keyless REST. Chain reads possible (public RPCs verified). Reader pending.

name: PancakeSwap
note: Info API dead (500). Chain reads possible via BSC RPC. Reader pending.

name: Aerodrome
note: No reachable API host. Covered via aggregators.

name: Rhea (NEAR)
note: NEAR RPC reads proven (8833 pools via view calls). Reader pending.

name: Public EVM RPCs
note: eth/base/arb/bsc endpoints verified working. Transport for future chain readers.

name: HawkFi
note: Solana + Robinhood LP terminal (strategies, MEV Boost, TP/SL). No public API: directory entry only.

name: Dune
note: API needs a key (401 without). dex.trades tables would serve both DEX rows and rankings. Slot ready, dormant until a key is added.

name: Coinglass
note: CEX derivatives data (funding, OI, liquidations) — read-only context for LP strategy, never pool rows. API needs a key.
